meeting.title: Flock Freight weekly sync
meeting.summary: First sync in three weeks with Flock Freight — Owen back from parental leave. Okta SSO reported done; metric definitions picked back up; Maya to re-baseline the timeline, Owen to deliver the shipment data dictionary.
action_items: Maya to re-baseline the implementation timeline by Thursday
Owen to draft the first ten metric definitions
Owen to deliver the shipment data dictionary by end of next week
key_decisions: Restart the rollout with a re-baselined timeline rather than chasing the original dates
meeting.notes: Three-week stall explained by champion's leave, not disengagement. Momentum restored.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Owen! Good to have you back — congratulations again.

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: Thanks Maya. Sorry the project went dark for three weeks, that was me, not the team losing interest.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: No apology needed. Let's rebuild the picture — where do things actually stand?

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: Better than you'd think. IT finished the Okta SAML SSO configuration while I was out — it's done, tested, people log in through Okta now.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Excellent, I'll stop chasing that one. The other open item on my board is the metric definitions.

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: Yeah, that one's still on me and still not started. We still owe you the metric definitions — I'll get the first ten drafted in the yml now that I'm back.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Good. Given the gap, I don't want to pretend the old dates still hold.

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: Agreed, chasing the original timeline would just stress everyone out.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Then I'll re-baseline the implementation timeline and send you the updated plan by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: Perfect. One more thing from our side — your team asked what fields we track per shipment.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Yes, we need that to model the shipment marts properly.

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: I'll deliver the shipment data dictionary by end of next week — it exists, it just needs cleaning up before I share it.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: That unblocks the modeling work nicely. Anything else in flight I should know about?

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: There's vague talk of a carrier-scorecard module on our roadmap that might want dashboards, but it's a quarter away at least.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Noted for later, not for the plan. Great to have you back, Owen.

transcript.speaker: Owen Brennan
transcript.text: Good to be back. Talk Thursday when the plan lands.

expected.notes: Ordinary weekly sync, all three action types: SSO done (update_status), metric-definitions commitment maps to the existing open 'Define first 10 metrics' task (match_existing, must NOT duplicate), plus one vendor and one customer create_task; the carrier-scorecard roadmap talk is not a task.
